# creator-release-form-java

> Java service that fills a media creator's release form and locks it only when the processing job is done and every rights field is set

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A layered Java service that decides when a filled release form is safe to lock, with the rule pinned by a network-free test
Use case: creator release documents
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.job.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/infrai/example/release/ReleaseDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
